# Zenotes AI Agent Integration Guide

> Zenotes is a privacy-first note-taking and knowledge base application.
> Notes are formatted in Markdown with support for multi-file and directory uploads.

## Master Global Token Authentication
Agents can access all notes and directories without session cookies:
- HTTP Header: `X-Global-Token: <token>`
- Or HTTP Header: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
- Or URL Parameter: `?token=<token>`
- Default master token: `zenotes_master_sec_token`

## API Endpoints
- **Search & List Notes**: `GET https://api.zenotes.site/api/global/notes?q={query}&token={token}`
- **Get Note Markdown**: `GET https://api.zenotes.site/api/global/notes/{noteId}/markdown?token={token}`
- **Download File**: `GET https://api.zenotes.site/api/global/notes/{noteId}/files/{fileId}?token={token}`
- **Export Note ZIP**: `GET https://api.zenotes.site/api/global/notes/{noteId}/export.zip?token={token}`
- **Export All Notes & Directories ZIP**: `GET https://api.zenotes.site/api/global/export-all.zip?token={token}`
- **Web UI Global Console**: `https://zenotes.site/global?token={token}`

## Quick Example
```bash
curl -s -H "X-Global-Token: zenotes_master_sec_token" "https://api.zenotes.site/api/global/notes?q="
```
